resources.string: Drafts chat replies in the AI app you pick

When you tap the bubble, the Draft reply tile or the accessibility button, Reply Drafter reads the chat on screen (scrolling back a little to get earlier messages), and opens the AI app you picked (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) with it, so the AI can draft a reply in your style. It can then paste the reply you copied into the message box. It never sends a message, and it reads nothing until you tap it. Only your own messages are kept on this phone, to learn how you write.
